title: Industrial Steam Turbine
description: The &3Industrial Steam Turbine&r is a multiblock machine that is a more powerful version of the &3Steam Engine&r. It has an efficiency of &e100%&r and energy output slowly ramps up as &bSteam&r is supplied and slowly goes down as steam cuts out. Additionally, it can process more dense versions of steam for more powerful reactor designs. It can process up to &e6MHE/s&r on normal steam.
